method.name: add_layer
method.description: Sets the layer at [param idx] to [param value]. If [param resource] is disabled (and is not [code]null[/code]), sets it to [code]null[/code] (see [member GaeaLayer.enabled]).

method.name: get_enabled_layers_indexes
method.description: Returns a list of the indexes of all non-[code]null[/code] layers.

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the value at layer [param idx].

method.name: get_layer_count
method.description: Returns the amount of layers the result has.
